Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS Sub: Enquiry for providing Air Conditioned, chauffeur driven, diesel passenger carrying four-wheeler vehicles 07 Nos (SEVEN NOS) (Bolero / Bolero Neo)- Having com mercial registration, vehicle model not earlier than January 2024 in good condition on monthly hire basis to BHEL for official use at NTPC, Talcher TPS for a period of 1 2 (Twelve) Months and further extended for 12 (twelve) months with mutual conse nt. Please find enclosed the tender document as per the following details: a) Terms & Conditions – Annexure “A” b) No Deviation Certificate – Annexure “B”.

c) Un price bid - Annexure “C” d) Declaration not Being Black Listed –Annexure -D e) Price Bid –Annexure -E Qualifying Creteria a) The Bidder must have provided satisfactory taxi services to Govt. organisations or Publi c Sector undertakings (PSUs) or reputed Private Organisations with at least 01 or more vehicles during last seven years as on latest date of offer submission having turnover of Rs. 27 Lakh for 07 No’s of Bolero Neo/Bolero in any of the year during past 7 years. Cop y of any one or more work orders of last Seven years fulfilling the qualifying the criteria must be enclosed along with satisfactory service certificate from the organisation. Cred entials submitted by the bidder against “PRE-QUALIFYING CRITERIAS” shall be verified f or its authenticity. In case, any credential (s) is/are found unauthentic, offer of the bidd er is liable to the rejection. b) PAN No – Bidder Should have PAN card. c) GST No- The bidder should have GST number and if GST number not available shall be obtained within one moth of time from the placement of PO /LOI. In case no applicability of GST, one undertaking should be given for the same highlighting the reasons for so. PAYMENT TERMS a. Bills shall be submitted for payment on monthly basis within 30 days after end of month. b. Vehicle owner will maintain logbook and will get each journey signed from the concerned official. Copy of the logbook will be submitted along with m onthly bill. Starting & closing journey will be reckoned from the garage not ified in the offer. c. Income Tax (TDS) shall be deducted at source from the running bill as per applicable Income Tax Rules and other statutory requirement from time to time. d. In case of award of the work, the payment will be made on monthly basis within 30 days through NEFT /RTGS only after receipt of the complete bill in duplicate and will be verified by Officer-in Charge for satisfactory completi on of the work. Bill will be processed only when the log book is properly fill ed, meter starting and Ending, purpose of journey is clearly mentioned, dri ver signature, user signature is made otherwise the bill cannot be processe d. No advance payment will be paid under any circumstances. (NEFT form at shall be enclosed along with the bill). For payment purpose NEFT format duly verified by concerned bank official & cancelled cheque may be submit ted along with the first bill. e. The BHEL shall not be responsible for any other payments either towards

running expenses, penalties/fines, repairs or salaries and wages of driver, l ocal/outstation boarding & lodging of driver etc. and also the whole respon sibility rests with contractor in case of accident or any other matter. Liquidated Damages Penalties: Ø The party has to deploy the required vehicles within 15 days of time from the date of award of work. Ø The vehicles provided by the contractor shall be maintained in excellent running condition during the p eriod of contract and the vehicle provided should be thoroughly washed and cleaned. The vehicle sha ll be used for local/outstation journeys by BHEL officials/Guests depending upon the requirement. Ø Air-conditioning system (Cooling/heating) should remain in operation as per requirement of travelling of ficials. No extra charges will be paid for it (As per Applicable) Ø Vehicle must be registered with concerned RTO shall be supplied to BHEL, TPS, Talcher Site and copies of proof of Registration certificate, road tax paid, insurances, Permit shall be submitted. Any further d ues on such vehicles shall be liability of the contractor. At the time of deployment of vehicle, the vend or should submit the above copies along with the details of the driver to be deployed along with his va lid driving license. Ø Copies of Renewal of insurance, road taxes, pollution certificate of Vehicles has to be submitted to the contracting department within 07 days of time from the date of expiry of the above. Failing to submit the renewal copies of insurance, road taxes of any vehicle, that vehicle will be discontinued form the deployment and an amount of Rs.500/- (Rupees Five Hundred Only) will be imposed as fine per day p er vehicle. Alternative arrangement will be made by BHEL on Risk purchase clause and the same shall be recovered from the contractor’s bill. Ø In case of on-route break down, the vehicle shall be replaced by suitable vehicle immediately. In case t he alternate vehicle is not provided, BHEL is free to engage another vehicle to complete the remainin g journey at the risk purchase clause and the same shall be recovered from the contractor’s bill. Ø In case of non-availability /non-providing the vehicle on any day, alternative vehicle of the same type s hould be provided or it shall be hired by BHEL on Risk purchase clause and the same shall be recove red from the contractor’s bill. Ø There is no limit of running of the vehicle on monthly basis. The odometer (distance meter) of the vehic le will be jointly signed by the owner or his authorized representatives and a person in charge, BHEL. No vehicle without working odometer shall be acceptable. Proper log book shall be maintained for eac h travel and has to be got signed by the guest /user travelling in the vehicle. TAXES & DUTIES: GST@5% to be discharged by BHEL under Reverse Charge Mechanism (RCM) directly to the Revenue depart ment. As the case may be, GST shall be paid extra as per GST rules and also applicable in case of any modification i n GST rules. Party will be solely responsible for payment of GST as applicable, if in case of any GST due arises due to default of the party, BHEL will not responsible for any default payment on account of GST. Any change s in GST rules will be applicable on the bidder. L1 CRITERIA: Ø L1 shall be decided on the basis of overall Lowest Quoted Value for the vehicle mentioned in the tender Document. Ø In the course of evaluation, if more than one bidder happens to occupy L-1 status, effective L-1 will be decided by soliciting discounts from the respective L-1 bidders. In case more than one bidder happens to occupy the L-1 status even after soliciting discounts, the L-1 bidder shall be decided by a toss / dra w of lots, in the presence of the respective L-1 bidder(s) or their representative(S). Ranking will be do ne accordingly. BHEL's decision in such situations shall be final and binding Ø There shall be no counter-offer

Following points relevant to the tender must be noted and complied with: · Bidder has to quote the lowest rate against each item of the schedule. · The rates quoted against each item of the work must be in figures and in words as well. Overwriting or erasures should be avoided. If, however, they exist, they must be invariably attested by the bidder (signed). · Validity of Bids must be for at least 90 days from the date of submission of the bid s. · ‘No Deviation Certificate’ in Annexure-B, unpriced bid declarations Annexure –C, de claration not being black listed in annexure -D in the enclosed format duly filled in (signed) is to be submitted by the bidder with the techno commercial bid of the ten der. · Offers with deviation from the tender requirements are liable to be rejected as per discretion of BHEL. · Issue of tender document & receipt of tender will be regulated as per NIT. · Bidders must adhere to the Terms & Conditions stipulated in the tender and quote accordingly. · BHEL reserves the right to accept or reject any bid without assigning any reason th ereof. BHEL also reserves the right to cancel the tender wholly or partly without as signing any reason. · All the 07 no’s (Seven) Bolero / Bolero Neo vehicles will be awarded to overall Low est (L1) bidder. 07 nos (SEVEN NOS) vehicles will be engaged immediately within 1 5 days of time from the date of placement of PO/LOI or as per the intimation issued by BHEL Site. · Tenders must be submitted through GEM Portal only.

· Bidders to submit copy of PAN Card details along with the Bid. · In the event of any conflict between requirements of any clause of this specificatio n/schedules etc. the same to be get cleared from BHEL before submission of bid. O therwise, more stringent requirement as may be interpreted by BHEL shall prevail and shall be binding on you. · Vehicles shall be hired for a period of 12 (twelve) Months and further extended for 12 (twelve) months with mutual consent. · Vehicle (s) shall be withdrawn at the discretion of BHEL without assigning reason w ith prior intimation of 30 day’s time from either of the parties. · The rate should be quoted carefully as per enclosed price Bid & Declaration should be given in Un-price bid. Value of L1 will be determined including GST on GEM Port al. · BHEL’s standard terms and conditions is enclosed. · LAST DATE OF SUBMISSION OF OFFER AS AVAILABLE AT GEM PORTAL. · Earnest Money Deposit (EMD): NIL · Security Deposit: NIL If any clarification in respect of the tender terms and conditions may be addressed to th e below mentioned officer through mail. The contact details are mentioned below. Contact Person: 1.Manoj Kumar Mall,Manager/HR(M)-8968368888) Mail ID – mkm@bhel.in

ANNEXURE-A Terms and Conditions 01. Monthly hire charges of vehicle should be quoted by bidder on the Price bid F ormat both in figure and Words. Any overwriting in prices mentioned figure i s not allowed. In case illegible price mentioned in figures, the price mentioned in words shall be taken in to consideration. 02. Daily normal duty hours will be for 12 hours i.e 8.00 AM to 8.00PM starting from reporting place and time. All these vehicles shall be used for the plain road and c onstruction site uneven roads as per BHEL Requirement. 03. All seven vehicles (Bolero/Bolero Neo) shall be deployed at the BHEL Project Sit e. The vehicles must be suitable for operating on various road conditions, includi ng muddy and uneven roads within the project site. 04. Over time shall be payable per hour basis beyond normal duty of 12 hours per d ay @ Rs.70/- per extra hour. Part of the hour will be paid on pro-rata rate per min ute basis i.e. Rs. (70/60) x extra minutes. 05. Fuel charges, shall be reimbursed @ ONE (01) litre of diesel for every 10KM run ning of Bolero Neo Vehicles with AC along with the monthly bill at the prevailing market rate of diesel of PSUs viz. IOCL, BPCL, HPCL etc. 06. Lubricant charges will be paid @ One Litre for every 500 KM run. For fraction of 500 KM, payment shall be pro-rated. 07. Monthly hired vehicle can be called for duty any time, so the vehicle cannot be engaged for any purpose other than BHEL. 08. Driver must report on duty in neat and clean uniform, free from intoxication and Contiguous diseases with proper ID cards. Any change in driver shall be intimate d by the vendor to the contract executing officer in charge for record and other c ompliances. 09. Driver must have a valid license and equipped with Mobile connectivity all the ti me round the clock. 10. The Vehicle must have neat & Clean Towels for seat and back. 11. In case of exigency, vehicle may be required to be parked at locations decided b y BHEL Officials without any additional charges. 12. The vehicle should report for duty in good condition, with Proper pressure in tyr es, good condition of tyres and with adequate quantity of fuel. 13. In case, BHEL makes any payment towards repair/fuel charges, the same will be recovered from your bills with 30% overhead. 14. All taxes, insurance charges, local police allegations/law and order (if any) will b e complied with/borne by owner. Making of all Gate passes (Temporary/permane nt/ Sunday / holiday / Night pass) for entering inside the plant area is owner’s res

ponsibility, as per applicability. 15. Compliance of all statutory laws, legal obligations, as per Motor Vehicle Act, in v ogue shall be responsibility of the owner. 16. Vehicle will be given One Day paid off for maintenance every month. 17. No compensation shall be payable on account of accident, idling due to reasons / conditions beyond the control of BHEL. 18. Self certified copies of all valid documents such as Owner’s book/valid registrati on certificate, Valid tax token, Comprehensive valid Insurance certificate, Driving License of the driver, fitness certificate & Pollution under control certificate, and o ther documents as required by customer /statutory authorities regarding vehicle have to be submitted on placement of order. Originals shall be produced for verification purposes. 19. Tenderer will not be allowed to assign or transfer the contract to third party. 20. Payment will be made through RTGS/NEFT only once in a month within 30 day s from submission of bill with all required documents as per prescribed format of BHEL. Bills should be accompanied with completed & signed log sheets signed by BHEL officials/representatives. BHEL reserve the right to terminate the services of vehicle contract anytime with a notice period of 30 days in writing during the con tract period, if the service of vehicle/vehicles / driver / owner is found un-satisfact ory. 21. It will be owner’s sole responsibility to bear all the liabilities whatsoever on acco unt of any loss or damage to any person or property in case the vehicle provided to BHEL meets an accident during duty hours during the contract period. 22. Mileage meter (Km indicator meter) must be maintained in proper working and sealed condition. BHEL reserves the right to terminate the contract at any point o f time without any notice, if the Km indicator of the vehicle is found tempered wit h at any point of time. 23. The Monthly rental charge offered shall remain firm throughout the contract per iod and BHEL shall not entertain any compensation/escalation whatsoever during the tenure of the contract. By considering all the factors, the vendor should quote the price in the tender. 24. Toll tax / Parking fee are reimbursable on production of receipt of payment sub mitted with monthly Bill. 25. Driver shall have to maintain log book as provided by BHEL for recording of runn ing distance in KM as per reading of the vehicle milometer for each day / trip and should ensure getting signature of the user. Reprinted logbooks shall be provided by BHEL & all the trips performed by the vehicle shall require to be maintained in logbook by the Driver with the signature of the user. The original copies of the lo gbook shall be submitted by the vendor to BHEL along with the bills

26. Acceptance of vehicle shall be the discretion of BHEL and in the event of dispute of any nature, decision of BHEL shall be final and binding on the bidder. 27. Quotations should be submitted on GEM Portal on or before the due date. 28. Offered rates shall be valid for entire contract period of 12 (Twelve) Months and further extended for 12 (twelve) months with mutual consent. 29. Contract will be made for a period of 12 (twelve) Months from the date of award of work and further extended for 12 (twelve) months with mutual consent. 30. Vehicle should be deployed for duty within 15 days of time from the date place ment of LOI /PO. ABSENCE ON DUTY: Substitute vehicle/Vehicles will be provided in case of absence of engaged vehicle/vehic les from duty with / without permission. In case of failure on the part of contractor to do so, other vehicle/vehicles may be hired from other agencies and extra expenditure. The Cost of the hiring on account of Risk purchase shall be recovered from the vendor’s bill. The loss arising out of accident, theft etc. while on duty shall entirely be borne by the o wner of the vehicle. BHEL shall not be responsible towards such losses as well as towar ds loss of life or injury to your and any other personnel. OBLIGATION TOWARDS DRIVER AND MAINTENANCE: All obligations towards the employment of driver/drivers with valid driving license, salar ies, accommodations etc will be on vehicle owner's account. All maintenance/servicing will be done by the owner. The payment of the drover and bearing, tearing, Insurance, Pollution certificate, road taxes, fitness certificate & permit shall not be linked with the payment of BHEL. PARKING OF VEHICLE: Parking mileage will be allowed maximum 8 km each way from the place of First pickup and last drop of BHEL Staff (Parking of vehicles shall be decided by Mutual consent of B HEL, TPS Site within the radius of 8 km from the place of First pick and last drop of the B HEL Staff prefereably Nalco Nagar Area).

If Vendor doesn’t agree to park the vehicle within the 8 km radius area, the expenses b eyond 8 km mileage shall be borne by the vendor. In case vehicle does not report for duty as per the time intimated to the driver and repo rts for duty after 1 hours (One hour) but within 03 (Three) hours from the scheduled rep orting time, 50% of the charges for the day will be deducted from the owner's bill. ANNEXURE-B

NO DEVIATION CERTIFICATE It is certified that we have gone through all terms and conditions mentioned in the enqu iry (Terms and conditions) and offer our unqualified acceptance of the same.
